title: Audio Proximity Class V1.5
description: Perceived distance class of Audio Objects relative to the user within an OSD-defined Virtual Space: a discrete proximity level, a confidence score, an optional distance estimate and the time window of the evaluation.

MInstanceID.description: ID of the Virtual Space the audio scene refers to.

AudioProximityClassID.description: Identifier of this Audio Proximity Class entry.

AudioProximityClass.description: List of proximity classifications, one per Audio Object.

AudioObjectID.description: Unique identifier of the Audio Object.

ProximityLevel.description: Discrete proximity class relative to the user.

ProximityConfidence.description: Confidence score associated with the proximity classification.

DistanceEstimate.description: Optional distance in metres from the user for the Audio Object.

DataXMData.description: Metadata optionally used for regulated exchange of Audio Proximity Class information.

Trace.description: Provenance trace including Source and Time per AIF V3.0 rules.
